basic_info.description: The ground floor unit showcases contemporary updates in a versatile living space featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms. The spacious eat-in kitchen is perfect for cooking and gatherings. The versatile space features a cleverly partitioned layout, with a custom wood slat wall separating the bedroom from a spacious living room and kitchenette, ideal for a home office, accommodating guests, or indulging in the luxuries of an expansive owner's suite. Hardwood floors exude timeless charm throughout the unit, while spacious closets offer ample storage solutions. Shared expansive roof deck, 1 car independent garage parking, private laundry with own stacked washer and dryer, and a large basement storage area complete this unit. Conveniently located, 1180C De Haro is moments away from abundant dining options with easy access to freeways and public transportation.
